The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
Good to see you. I just thought you'd be here...\nYes, we also heard about the vicious black knight\nand came to find him.
So, you also think it's Ruzart...?\nI knew it. Now that he's cornered, we never know\nwhat he may do next... Anyway...
I can't forgive him for disguising himself as the\nblack knight and doing evil!
Um... Y-You know! I understand how the black\nknight may feel. I also can't forgive those\nwho besmirch the knight's name...
Oh, no!! Balft...!\nWe've gotta go down there right now...
Well, according to the instructions, it should be\nsomewhere around here...But wait, would the\nmaterial show up in a place like this?
Oh, hi!\nWhat are you guys doing here?
We're here for an errand.\nThere's some material...
Wait, what's that thing? Your pet?
It is made with the refined magic icing sugar I\ncreated to make food move like a living creature.
So, what do you think? This artwork of marshmallow\nI created doesn't only taste better, but also\nlooks classier than the sweets that hick made...
Meh. It's just another misdirected effort...\nSo whatever. It has nothing to do with the errand\nwe're running anyway.
Hey! What is it doing?!\nMove it aside!
Oh dear! I'm not doing it on purpose.\nI just made it so I think I still don't know how\nto control it properly.
Arggghhh...!\nGimme a break!\nStop it now or we'll move it by force!
Would you stop picking a fight with me?\nTry and do it if you think you can!
Ugh?!\nI-it's heavier than I thought...\nHey! Don't just watch, hurry and do something!
So you really can't control it.\nWe can just ignore it if we want, but it could\nalso be a hindrance to our task...
Hey!!\nForget about the material. Rescuing me now should\nbe your top priority. Isn't it obvious?!
Argh, just shut up already! What a nuisance......!
For god's sake, why did things turn out this way?\nWe didn't find what we're looking for, it's all\nbecause of you...
Oh well, let's go back for now!\nThe information of the material could have been\nwrong.
I-I'm coming with you!\nI wanna complain too, otherwise I won't feel good!
Wait, wait, listen. It's you who poked your nose\nin and ended up getting crushed by the weird stuff\nyou created yourself, okay...?
Is there anything left undone?\n[ffff64]*Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back to El Scaro!
